A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ElasticMM study. Their complete text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–B support reliable comparison, including content shifted by pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original latency, throughput, and ablation experiments in Section 4, plus output-consistency results over 1,000 prompts in Appendix B.9.

after.justification: v2 retains the original Section 4 experiments and Appendix B.9 output-consistency results, including Table 2.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same modality-aware allocation, stage scheduling, gain-cost rules, unified prefix caching, and non-blocking encoding. The revised overview diagram illustrates the existing procedure rather than introducing a new component.

E1.justification: Both use VisualWebInstruct, ShareGPT-4o, mixed-source ablation requests, and production-trace-based workloads. Removing the illustrative daily workload plot does not establish removal of any dataset or evaluation scenario.

E2.justification: The latency comparisons retain vLLM and vLLM-Decouple; throughput, ablation, and Appendix B comparator sets also match. SGLang and DeepSpeed-FastGen remain unevaluated despite deletion of the sentence explaining their exclusion.

E3.justification: The models, eight-A800 testbed, arrival generation, normalized latency metrics, SLO scaling, and 1,000-prompt consistency test are unchanged. The new figure caption and compatibility note clarify existing experiments without establishing revised settings.

E4.justification: v1 Figure 2's workload characterization, contrasting steady text-only traffic with bursty image-text traffic and marking short- and long-term behavior, is removed. The resource-allocation and inference-optimization ablations and Appendix B.9 consistency analysis remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged: neither version supplies replicate-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the performance experiments. Appendix B.4 retains the same statement about fixing random seeds across instances.

E6.justification: The daily request-rate series in v1 Figure 2 is removed, although its qualitative workload description remains with prior-work attribution. Matched performance and ablation plots are unchanged, as is Table 2: both models retain 100% identical outputs and average token-probability differences below 10^-8.

T1.justification: The burst-tolerance and gain-cost equations remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same definitions, inference-equivalence theorem, six lemmas, numerical-stability proposition, and proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same two-level decoupling and elasticity contributions and headline performance claims. Replacing 'propose' with 'introduce' in the abstract does not change scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations involving resource contention, dynamic allocation, caching, and encoding interference remain unchanged, as do the single-node limitation and numerical-stability qualifications. The added related-work contrast applies the existing modality-isolation rationale without revising that mechanism.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly clarifies that the vLLM 0.6.6 architecture includes added model code supporting Qwen2.5-VL. Figure 1's caption now identifies ShareGPT-4o and LLaMA3.2-11B as its experimental context. Appendix A's implementation details are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds ModServe and Singh et al.'s EPD-disaggregation work. Sections 1 and 3.1 attribute workload observations to ModServe, while Section 5 distinguishes ElasticMM's modality isolation plus stage separation from these earlier approaches. The broader positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Edits are localized: the abstract changes one verb, Section 2.3 rephrases Key Insight 1 and adjusts paragraph breaks, and baseline and related-work passages are revised. The overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: v2 removes the daily trace figure, revises the overview diagram's labels, arrows, colors, and group outlines, and expands Figure 1's caption. Subsequent figures are renumbered and text reflows; retained experimental plots and tables preserve their displays.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves transparency through the Figure 1 dataset identification and vLLM compatibility clarification, and improves positioning through explicit discussion of ModServe and EPD disaggregation. Removing the daily trace reduces self-contained motivating evidence, but the main experiments and complete appendices remain intact. The net gain is limited clarification and attribution, not stronger experimental validation.
